verdict.rationale: Sentry's Seer/Autofix feature explicitly scans incoming issues to automatically find root causes and automate triage, and the Seer Agent can answer questions about telemetry to give responders context (sentry-docs-5, sentry-docs-30, sentry-docs-31, sentry-docs-17). This directly matches AI-generated incident summaries/context for responders, and alerting integrations (Slack, incident.io) deliver that context where responders work (sentry-docs-3, sentry-intdir-9). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence validating the quality and accuracy of these AI summaries, and no explicit example of a generated 'incident summary' artifact (only root-cause/triage automation is documented).
